Subte en Vivo is an app that shows you the status of the Buenos Aires Subway in real time, showing status, frequency and important information about it.

FEATURES

+ Explore
• All the Buenos Aires subway and metro lines (A, B, C, D, E, H, P).-
• Colors for each subway line.-
• Status for each subway line.-
• Frequency for each subway line.-
• Optionally change what information you want to display.-

+ Discover
• All the Buenos Aires subway and metro lines (A, B, C, D, E, H, P).-
• Colors for each subway line.-
• Status for each subway line.-
• Main Station name for each subway line.-
• Service schedule for each subway line.-

+ Swipe
• Hidden menu to avoid distractions with just a swipe to access all.-

+ Configure It
• Decide which information to display.-
• Opt to receive different notifications.-
• 3D touch support so you can easily change the notifications for each line and by day (Only for devices with 3D touch support).-

+ Alerts
• Real time.-
• Rich Notifications.-
• The whole subway network.-
• Reports including delays, interruptions, eventualities, end of service and more.-
• Fully configurable by day or line, so you receive only what matters to you.-

+ Supported Languages
• Español.-
• English.-

+ Other
• Dark Mode (+iOS13).-
• Widgets (+iOS14).-

+ FREE
• We want that anyone can use our app, and have the best experience.-

+ PRIVACY
• Subte en Vivo does not collect any type of user information. The only information collected is over the App usage, and logs on error or problem.

We update the app regularly so we can make it better for you. Get the latest version for all of the available features and improvements. Thanks for using Subte en Vivo!
